'''October 2000 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Grasshopper's Comics, Williston Park, NY on 28 October 2000. [[Matt Ehrhart]] won it. It is known from Brad Vogel's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1397">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-williston-park-new-york-10-28-00d1397/ williston-park-new-york-10-28-00], DeckTech (Brad "Uncle Chall" Vogel, 29 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-williston-park-new-york-10-28-00d1397/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Grasshopper's Comics, Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Ehrhart]]
